about.title: About Us
about.p1: We exist to build a foresight ecosystem that speaks our language, reflects our diversity, and reclaims our agency in shaping tomorrow. Rooted in our shared culture yet connected globally, we bridge scholarship, movement, and practice to build capacities, cultivate thought leadership, and democratise access to futures thinking.{br} We believe foresight is not only a discipline but a cultural right: the right to imagine futures on our own terms.
about.breakoutDescription: We aspire to make foresight equitable and connected, accessible to all and reflective of our shared humanity. are guided by an Arab ethos of trust, humility, and courage before the unknown, acting with clarity even amid uncertainty.

ParticipatoryAndInclusive.label: Inclusion & Collective Ownership
ParticipatoryAndInclusive.value: We are participatory, fostering inclusion and collective ownership of the future.

UpholdingAgency.label: Empowerment & Agency
UpholdingAgency.value: We uphold agency, empowering individuals and institutions to shape their own trajectories.

ChampioningRepresentation.label: Authentic Arab Representation
ChampioningRepresentation.value: We champion representation, so Arab futures are told by Arab voices.

impaPioneeringAndAdaptivect.label: Pioneering & Future-Focused
impaPioneeringAndAdaptivect.value: We are pioneering, driven to challenge, adapt, and create what our region needs.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: A future where the Arab world is a global leader in innovation, culture, and sustainable development, driven by the foresight and creativity of its people.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To cultivate a foresight culture across the Arab region by providing accessible knowledge, fostering collaborative networks, and initiating impactful future-oriented projects.

features.heading: The Arab Futures Lexicon
features.subheading: The first regional effort to unify and evolve the language of foresight in Arabic
features.description: For decades, futures terminology has been scattered across translations, institutions, and publications, creating fragmentation and barriers for researchers, policymakers, and educators. This initiative addresses that gap by creating a living, collaborative, and authoritative reference for Arabic foresight terminology. It serves as both a knowledge base and a community platform, where experts and contributors work together to shape the evolving language of Arab futures.

termsPage.title: The Arab Futures Lexicon
termsPage.description_1: The Arab Futures Lexicon is the first regional effort to unify and evolve the language of foresight in Arabic.
termsPage.description_2: For decades, futures terminology has been scattered across translations, institutions, and publications, creating fragmentation and barriers for researchers, policymakers, and educators.
termsPage.description_3: This initiative addresses that gap by creating a living, collaborative, and authoritative reference for Arabic foresight terminology. It serves as both a knowledge base and a community platform, where experts and contributors work together to shape the evolving language of Arab futures.

why_it_matters.title: Why It Matters
why_it_matters.intro: Language shapes imagination, and imagination shapes the future.
why_it_matters.subtitle: By developing a shared, contextually rooted lexicon, we are:
points: Enabling regional foresight capacity: Scholars, practitioners, and institutions gain a unified reference, reducing duplication and confusion.
Strengthening cultural sovereignty: The Arab world develops its own conceptual vocabulary of futures, independent yet globally connected.
Democratizing access to foresight: Translators, students, and emerging futurists gain free access to knowledge once locked in academic silos.
Preserving and evolving the Arabic language: Ensuring Arabic remains a language capable of leading global conversations about the future.

what_makes_it_different.title: What Makes It Different
points: Collaborative design: Experts and contributors across the Arab world can suggest, debate, and refine terminology.
Rigorous methodology: Every translation is annotated, sourced, and reviewed for contextual precision.
Open access: The platform will remain free and public, embodying our mission to democratize foresight knowledge.
Scalable foundation: Future versions will include sectoral lexicons (e.g., climate, AI, governance) and bilingual search capabilities.
